biography: I began my professional career as a construction project manager for MFS Communications, Parsippany, NJ 1994. Project load was in all of the Tier 1 US markets building new Telco Central Offices. When WorldCom purchased MFS in 1996 I was relocated to Dallas and promoted to Senior Manager of Engineering and Construction. My new role was building customer serving hosting centers, new local/ long distance central offices, data centers and colocation facilities. I've traveled over 2 million air miles, been a first responder with operations during every natural disaster since 1994. Hurricane Katrina, Sandy, Harvey and 911. I left Verizon in October 2017. Took 3 months off to recharge before joining zColo/Zayo in January of 2018. I started my career again with a data center specific company vs. mixing in the traditional telecom. I've built Tier 1-4 premium data centers across the US, operated them and maintained them. I've welcomed the challenges and embraced my new team of infrastructure engineers owning over 68 PDCs both US and Canada. Sizes range from 25,000-450,000 square feet housing 1-60mW of protected designed power. Operating at a national level, keeping up with standard applications and promoting consistency. zColo was acquired by DataBank in December 2020. After the acquisition I was promoted to VP of Critical Facility Infrastructure for the US. Their portfolio consists of 68 premium data centers in 30 US markets. I voluntarily left DB in early August 2022. Within 2 weeks I was blessed to onboard with the best in the biz, Digital Realty!!!.......Design and Construction responsibilities once again and so blessed for the opportunity! Very humbled how quickly I was retained. I thank my former peers and colleagues for the journey.
